video.sample_encoding: Shared JPEG frames at quality 95 from original decoded frames

single_retrained.training_source: ClassRoom v1 original 450 images, train 316 / val 88 / test 46

observations: The retrained single-source model often produces large boxes covering furniture or multiple people
The unified model separates individual upper bodies more consistently in reviewed frames
The unified model has false positives on the rear board and sometimes an empty chair, plus duplicate boxes and misses
limitations: No ground truth boxes: no precision, recall, mAP or counting accuracy computed
Box count is not the number of correctly detected people
Retrained single-source checkpoint is not the original report checkpoint
Sampled-frame detector comparison does not evaluate identity tracking, attendance or full-pipeline FPS

illustration.scope: Privacy-edited visual illustration, not a pixel-exact inference artifact; original box/text details can differ
illustration.numeric_source: sampled-box-counts.csv and actual inference records, not edited illustration
